items.title: Cigna Reports Earnings Thursday With New CEO, New Business Model
items.summary: Cigna Group will report its earnings on Thursday under its new chief executive, Brian Evanko. It’s transitioning its pharmacy benefits business to a rebate-free model.

items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Launches Retail Private Markets Fund As CEO Backs Crypto Bill
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) and T. Rowe Price have partnered to launch a private markets interval fund aimed at retail investors. The new fund is designed to give individuals access to private market exposure that has typically been limited to institutions. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon has publicly backed the revised Crypto Clarity Act, a rare break from the stance of many large bank leaders. items.title: AI-Fueled Demand Signals a Bigger Opportunity for Bloom Energy (BE) Investors
items.summary: According to Goldman Sachs projections, U.S. data center power demand could more than double from 31 gigawatts in 2025 to 66 gigawatts by 2027. BloombergNEF also estimates that data centers could account for 20% of U.S. electricity consumption by 2035. items.title: Market Indexes Tumble on Geopolitical Tensions and Chip Stock Selloff
items.summary: The Dow dropped over 900 points as Iran tensions pushed oil prices sharply higher. Semiconductor stocks extended their brutal weekly decline.

items.title: Bank Stocks Drop From Record Highs Ahead of Fed Meeting
items.summary: Goldman’s stock, which fell 4.6%, was on track for its worst performance in two months.  Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and Bank of America—all of which hit records this month, too—dropped 3.4%, 2.3%, and 1.2%, respectively on Wednesday.  Citi was down 3.3%, and Wells Fargo dropped 2%.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, Houlihan Lokey lead H1 2026 M&A adviser rankings
items.summary: Goldman Sachs advised on transactions worth $597.4bn, while Houlihan Lokey led the volume table with 152 deals.
